summary: Iteration 136: checked the round-2 fixes for the iteration_135 findings. Backend: pytest 83/83 passed (new test_cloudivr_iter136_ssrf_fixes.py with 22 tests, plus the 3cx edge_cases and features_pod suites). Node unit check of safe-url.js: 24/24. Regression harnesses gave the expected results: 16/16, 48/48, 61/61 and 99/100 (the one failure, 'bot auto-renew charges the re-checked price', is the known older failure). UI was tested with Playwright at 1920, 1366, 1024 and 390 px. PASS: 1, 1b, 1c, 1d, 1e, 2 (eye toggle and 390 layout), 3a, 3b, 3c, 3d, 3e, 3f, 3g, 4 (desktop, FR/ES, 390, keyboard, close methods, Help re-open, Show-me links), 5. Problems found: (a) loading /cloudivr/app/settings#webhooks directly does not scroll to the card; (b) a brand-new account created today does see the What's New card; plus 4 low-severity issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /cloudivr/app/settings#webhooks directly does not reach the Call events card. The page always stops at scrollY=712, leaving the card top 953 px down a 1080 px viewport (desktop) and 2344 px down at 390 px. Cause: scrollIntoView runs once, as soon as #settings-webhooks exists, while the cards above are still loading and the page is short, so the scroll is cut short and never redone. In-app navigation from What's New 'Show me' does work (card top at 306 px).
Page overflows sideways at 1024 width (scrollWidth 1040). The logout button [data-testid=topbar-logout-button] is partly off-screen.

Once in 9 clicks, 'Show me' for summary went to /cloudivr/app/numbers instead of ?tab=logs. numberLink() falls back to /app/numbers while numbers is still null, or [] after a failed fetch. Not reproduced on 4 retries.

integration_issues.issue: RELEASE.since is set to a future date (2026-10-26) instead of the release time. Every account that signs up before that date - including one created minutes ago on 2026-10-25 - sees 'What's new', on top of the new-user onboarding. This goes against the stated intent that for new accounts these features are simply part of the app.

design_issues.screen: Text Triggers action tiles, FR at 390px
issues: 'Rappel automatique' breaks in the middle of the word ('automatiq' / 'ue'). It stays inside the border but looks broken; use hyphens:auto with lang=fr, or a smaller font or a single-column layout on narrow screens
The card opens scrolled to the bottom: focusing 'Got it' scrolls the card's own scroll area, so the title and first items start out of view. Use focus({preventScroll:true})

design_issues.screen: Number tab strip at 1920 with Billing active
issues: Overview is cut by 15 px, but only because Billing has to be visible; acceptable, mentioned for completeness

action_items: Settings.js hash scroll: scroll again once the cards have loaded (e.g. scroll after the webhooks/data fetch finishes, or retry until the target's position stops moving) so a direct load of #webhooks lands on the card
WhatsNew.js: set RELEASE.since to the release/deploy time (<= now, e.g. 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z), or use a timestamp from the server or build, so brand-new sign-ups do not see the card
Top bar at 1024px: stop the overflow (hide 'Signed in as', compact the buttons) so the logout button is fully visible
WhatsNew 'Show me': wait for /numbers before navigating (or disable the buttons until it has loaded) to avoid the /app/numbers fallback
WhatsNew: focus 'Got it' with {preventScroll:true} so the mobile card opens at the top
FR trigger tiles at 390px: avoid breaking words mid-word
critical_code_review_comments: safe-url.js: covers IPv4-mapped/translated IPv6, NAT64, CGNAT and single-label names; checks every DNS answer when saving and again at connect time through safeLookup on all three senders (events, SMS forward, reseller). Looks solid. Note: checkUrl accepts names that do not resolve right now (by design), so the connect-time check is the real protection; it is in place
Bot SMS-forward (cp_265b) and the reseller webhook still allow http:// to public hosts (httpsOnly:false). This is consistent with the old behaviour, but http to a public host is still allowed
WhatsNew: the numbers list is fetched once per mount and the fallback uses the same path whether the fetch is still loading or has failed
